description: This file defines the class 'SqlServerStorageForTesting', a specialized implementation for testing SQL Server storage within an Orleans project. It provides methods and properties to generate SQL commands for database creation, deletion, existence check, and setup scripts specific to testing scenarios.

classes.name: SqlServerStorageForTesting
classes.description: A test utility class for managing SQL Server storage scenarios in unit tests, inheriting from RelationalStorageForTesting.

methods.name: ProviderMoniker
methods.description: Overrides the provider moniker to specify SQL Server.

methods.name: SqlServerStorageForTesting
methods.description: Constructor initializing the storage with a connection string, defaulting to a test configuration if none is provided.

methods.name: CancellationTestQuery
methods.description: Returns a SQL query used to test cancellation, involving a delay.

methods.name: CreateStreamTestTable
methods.description: Returns the SQL statement to create a streaming test table.

methods.name: CreateDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Provides the SQL template to create a new database for testing purposes.

methods.name: DropDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Provides the SQL template to drop a database used in testing.

methods.name: ExistsDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Provides the SQL query to check if a database exists.

methods.name: ConvertToExecutableBatches
methods.description: Splits a setup script into executable batches and appends recovery mode setting and test table creation commands.
